_comment: Whole-word replacements applied to text before speech generation. Keep the on-screen text unchanged.

phonics._comment: Letter sounds as phonemes, [label](/sounds/), so the engine says the sound and not the letter name (plain "b" is read as "bee", "fff" as "eff eff eff"). Short vowels; stops with a tiny uh; long sounds held. Each generated sound must be listen-checked and approved.
